symbols.name: apply
symbols.description: Applies serde transformations in unified mode.

symbols.name: apply_phases
symbols.description: Applies serde transformations in split-phase mode.

symbols.name: Error
symbols.description: Error type for serde transformation and validation failures.

symbols.name: Phase
symbols.description: Selects which directional type shape to use after apply_phases.

symbols.name: Phase::Deserialize
symbols.description: The shape used when Rust deserializes data from the wire.

symbols.name: Phase::Serialize
symbols.description: The shape used when Rust serializes data to the wire.

symbols.name: phased
symbols.description: Builds an explicit phased DataType from precomputed serialize and deserialize shapes.
symbols.signature: fn phased(serialize: specta::datatype::DataType, deserialize: specta::datatype::DataType) -> specta::datatype::DataType

symbols.name: Phased
symbols.description: Declares an explicit serialize/deserialize type pair for Specta output.

symbols.name: select_phase_datatype
symbols.description: Rewrites a DataType to the requested directional shape after apply_phases.
symbols.signature: fn select_phase_datatype(dt: &specta::datatype::DataType, types: &specta::ResolvedTypes, phase: Phase) -> specta::datatype::DataType

symbols.name: validate
symbols.description: Validates whether a given DataType is a valid Serde-type.
